_provenance.notes: Comprehensive record of federal commercial fishery disaster determinations made by the US Secretary of Commerce under MSA Section 312(a) and IFA Section 308(d) for Alaska fisheries from 1989 to 2024. Over $650M in federal disaster assistance has been allocated to Alaska fishermen, processors, municipalities, and tribal communities.
